title: Agentic Verified Optimization of Real-World Software
abstract: arXiv:2610.30188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Program optimization aims to improve performance while preserving behavior. Coding agents can already make programs faster by changing algorithms, data structures, and execution strategies. However, existing equivalence checks mostly rely on tests, which agents have been shown to exploit, passing the tests without preserving the intended behavior. We propose agentic verified optimization, in which an agent produces a faster implementation together with a machine-checked proof of equivalence to the existing one. Because the existing implementation serves as the specification, the task avoids the specification-writing bottleneck of verified code generation, and recent advances in theorem proving make the proofs attainable. We formulate the task at the function and repository levels in Lean 4, where programs can be both executed and reasoned about. translated_title: 真实世界软件的智能体验证优化
translated_abstract: 程序优化旨在在保持程序行为不变的前提下提升性能。编码智能体已经能够通过改变算法、数据结构和执行策略来让程序运行得更快。然而，现有的等价性检查大多依赖于测试，而已有研究表明智能体会利用测试的漏洞，在不保留预期行为的情况下通过测试。我们提出智能体验证优化，其中智能体在生成更快实现的同时，还需提供与现有实现等价性的机器验证证明。由于现有实现本身充当规约，该任务避免了验证代码生成中编写规约的瓶颈，而定理证明领域的最新进展使得这些证明变得可行。我们在 Lean 4 中于函数和代码仓库两个层面定义了该任务，在 Lean 4 中程序既可以被执行也可以被推理验证。由于很少有真实世界的应用是用 Lean 编写的，因此我们开发了 Aqueduct，一个智能体框架（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“智能体验证优化”新任务：让AI智能体生成更快的程序实现，同时产出以现有实现为规约的机器验证等价性证明，从而避免测试漏洞，并在Lean 4中开发Aqueduct框架将其应用于真实世界软件。
